name: NewServiceConnectionDesk
tagline: From application to meter set – load, transformer, fees, crews and energisation in one desk.
description: New-service and service-upgrade desk for electric utilities: completeness checks and information requests, design assignment, demand kVA and transformer capacity roll-up, line-extension fee quotes with upgrades and allowances, payments, easements, crew scheduling and inspection-gated energisation with SLAs – in canvas, model-driven and a Power Pages customer / electrician portal.
features: Completeness check before design and information requests with stall detection
Demand kVA per application and transformer roll-up against the loading limit
Fee estimate: connection fee, line extension, transformer upgrade, residential allowance
Quotes with validity, payments, waivers and QuoteJson for quote letters
Easement and electrical inspection gates before construction and meter set
Crew schedule with day capacity, missed appointments and ScheduleJson
Design SLA, energise SLA, requested in-service date and on-time %
Bulk assign / schedule / hold, undo, CSV export
Customer / electrician portal role with the short application form
Power Fx outputs and events, demo mode, phone layout
